<thought>By examining the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 132.43, 130.27, 129.30, 126.70, 126.66, and 123.57 ppm. That corresponds to six distinct aromatic carbon signals, indicating six aromatic carbon atoms in the compound.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
